name: code-quality
description: Code quality and review for production systems. Bundles a strict distributed-systems code reviewer (PRs, diffs, and implementation plans) with a disciplined BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/QUESTION severity model, and TypeScript quality patterns (typed clients with timeouts, Zod boundary validation, structured domain errors, no-any on public surfaces, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, PII redaction). The official-tier home for the marketplace's code-review and code-quality skills (ADR-0008 group 6).
